title: Turkish-Style German Apple Strudel
description: A twist on the classic German dessert, incorporating the flavors of Turkish cuisine.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced apples, chopped onions, fenugreek leaves, cinnamon, and Turkish Spice Mix.
Spread the apple mixture evenly over the center of the pastry dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the kunefe and granulated sugar over the apple mixture.
Fold the 1-inch border over the apple mixture to seal the strudel.
Brush the melted butter over the pastry dough.
Bake the strudel for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the strudel cool for 10 minutes before serving.
